# Production pure-water molecular Rayleigh scattering length for Water_Default.
# MODEL: Zhang & Hu 2009 PMH density-derivative model + Einstein-Smoluchowski-Cabannes.

# Isothermal compressibility: Kell correlation evaluated at 21.5 C.
